title: Pixel Watch 5 Review: One Week Later, We Still Have Unfinished Business
summary: You’ve probably caught on that I like the Pixel Watch’s look. The Pixel Watch 5 uses the same dual-band GPS introduced with the Pixel Watch 4, but Google says this year’s accuracy gains come largely from software.
